research.title: Surface Defect Classification with Handcrafted Visual Features
bullets: Prepared surface inspection images by checking defect labels, standardizing image dimensions, and grouping related samples to prevent overlap between evaluation splits.
Implemented a baseline classifier using local texture descriptors and a support vector machine, then reviewed confusion matrices to characterize common classification errors.

work.title: Inventory Records and Order Documentation
bullets: Checked incoming delivery paperwork against purchase records, logged discrepancies, and routed incomplete documentation to the appropriate staff for follow-up.
Maintained inventory filing records, organized order forms, and prepared routine handover notes covering outstanding requests and pending delivery confirmations.

projects.title: Pedestrian Classification Using Gradient Features
bullets: Implemented a baseline pedestrian image classifier using histogram of oriented gradients features and a linear support vector machine in scikit-learn.
Evaluated predictions on held-out image crops and inspected false positives associated with vertical background structures, partial occlusion, and low contrast.
